questions.stemHtml: A 29-Year-old female came to AIIMS OPD with amenorrhea for 8 weeks. UPT was positive. The obstetrician asked you to take the history of the patient. Significant history points include – the previous history of C-section 2 years back due to a major degree of anterior placenta previa (completely) with placenta attached to the anterior uterine wall. On P/A examination abdominal scar was present. Which of the following would be the type of uterine incision made in this patient in the previous C-section?
